asked: Brief 320, phase H3: the first Guild Hall star list. For every skill with content, XP, yield and speed boosts at one rank per tier; Token upgrades for its Tokens (vein rest, regrowth, camp reach where camps exist); the Well's basic outputs; the Hearth's Infirmary and loadout slots; each rank's tier set and its price proposed by the ledger (a preview).

stages.note: Typical buys the Starter Camp's first work-speed, XP and Well ranks (the first XP rank doubles the XP of 1-XP work), so the camp's levels come sooner: about 4.6 h to 2.1 h with the ledger's plan tiers in, 7.2 h to 6.1 h on data/ alone.
Plane 1's cooking and farming come sooner with the Hall's ranks: about 20 min to 10 min with the ledger's plan tiers in.
Plane 2's iron, fir, trout and grapes come sooner with the Hall's ranks: about 7.2 h to 5.3 h with the ledger's plan tiers in.
